title: Operator Quickpatchlet CLI for safe ephemeral remediations
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a lightweight CLI (Quickpatchlet) that can run curated, idempotent remediation fragments (ephemeral runbook tasks) against production services with enforced safety rails. The CLI should support: scoped dry-run, automatic post-run audit events, RBAC checks, and an approve-step via the Console or SSO. Goal is to shorten mean-time-to-fix for low-risk operator actions while preserving auditability and preventing accidental blast radius.
acceptance_criteria: CLI binary published to internal artifacts and accessible via brew/tap or artifact proxy
Quickpatchlet can execute a defined task fragment in dry-run mode without making changes
All executions write an immutable audit event to the ops-audit store with actor, diff, and run metadata
RBAC prevents non-approved roles from executing tasks that touch production clusters
A fail-safe timeout and automatic rollback exists for any task that registers a reversible change
E2E demo run documented and reproducible by oncall engineers

2026-03-04 — Security review notes: require KMS-wrapped signing for approved runs and record signed attestations. Follow-up task created to integrate KMS: ENG-246813

2026-03-08 — QA: validated dry-run semantics against staging, discovered an ordering race when scaling down multiple worker pools — mitigation: add linearized locks and semaphore support (patched in PR #7890).
2026-03-10 — PM feedback: request CLI UX addition to show recommended rollback command after apply. Added to acceptance criteria and small UI copy update in console rollout.
Links: design doc https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Quickpatchlet+Design, PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/7890, demo notes https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Qx-demo
implementation_notes: Architecture: CLI -> operator-agent (authenticated gRPC) -> orchestrator service (verifies RBAC, writes audit event, enqueues job). Use existing operator-agent auth tokens and integrate KMS for signature on approve. Use prefix/KV cache guard to avoid stale state when running 'rotate cache keys' fragment.
risks_and_mitigations: Accidental blast radius — mitigation: restrict initial fragments to low-risk operations and require approval for cluster-wide changes
Audit bloat — mitigation: summarize diffs and store compressed payloads, keep full payloads in cold storage
Race conditions during concurrent runs — mitigation: implement shard-level locks and transactional ops in orchestrator
test_plan: Unit tests for CLI parsing and dry-run flag behavior
Integration tests: run fragments against staging clusters in a sandboxed namespace
Chaos test: run concurrent fragment invocations to verify lock/semaphore correctness
Security test: verify that revoked RBAC tokens cannot execute tasks
